sloka: दैन्यम् हि नगरी गच्चेद् दृष्ट्वा शून्यम् इमम् रथम् ।सूत अवशेषम् स्वम् सैन्यम् हत वीरम् इव आहवे ॥२-५२-४१॥
transliteration: dainyam hi nagarī gacced dṛṣṭvā śūnyam imam ratham ।sūta avaśeṣam svam sainyam hata vīram iva āhave ॥2-52-41॥

translations.english: Seeing the empty chariot the people of the city will look pitiable just like an army left only with the charioteer after its hero is killed in the war.
